editorial.name: Pandora's Items III
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. ; Gain 1 Radiant item.

editorial.name: Partial Ascension
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

editorial.name: Patience Is A Virtue
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 5 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

editorial.name: Patient Study
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: After player combat, gain 2 XP if you won or 3 XP if you lost.

editorial.name: Pilfer
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 21 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

editorial.name: Plot Armor
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 10 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 50% Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

editorial.name: Portable Forge
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

editorial.name: Prismatic Destiny
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 2 gold.

editorial.name: Prismatic Destiny+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 7 gold.

editorial.name: Prismatic Ticket
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

editorial.name: Promised Protection
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 175 max Health.

editorial.name: Quick Streaks
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

editorial.name: Radiant Rascal
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

editorial.name: Radiant Relics
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

editorial.name: Recombobulator
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers and 3 free rerolls.

editorial.name: Replication
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

editorial.name: Residual Magic
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 60 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

editorial.name: Residual Magic +
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 75 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

editorial.name: Residual Magic ++
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 90 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

editorial.name: Retribution
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and 15% Critical Strike Chance. ; Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

editorial.name: Rolling For Days
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 10 free Shop rerolls.

editorial.name: Salvage Bin
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

editorial.name: Salvage Bin+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

editorial.name: Seraphim's Staff
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants 2 additional Mana Regen if its holder has 110% or more Ability Power.

editorial.name: Shimmerscale Essence
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After 6 player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

editorial.name: Shopping Spree
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: When you level up, gain a number of Shop refreshes equal to your level +1. Gain 7 gold.

editorial.name: Silver Destiny
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

editorial.name: Silver Destiny+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

editorial.name: Silver Destiny++
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

editorial.name: Silver Spoon
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 10 XP.

editorial.name: Slammin'
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 3 gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

editorial.name: Slammin'+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 4 gold and 10 XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

editorial.name: Slice of Life
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

editorial.name: Small Furry Friend
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: While Sprykin is active, gain a second BFF summon that is 45% as powerful. Gain a Teemo, a Veigar, and a Kobuko.

editorial.name: Small Grab Bag
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 random item components.

editorial.name: Solo Leveling
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

editorial.name: Solo Plate
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 17% max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

editorial.name: Soul Awakening
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Combat start: Your team gains 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for 10 seconds. At max stacks, deal 12% bonus true damage.

editorial.name: Speedy Double Kill
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain 40 gold. ; Fates Championship, 2021

editorial.name: Spirit Of Redemption
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every 5 seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within 1 hex for 9% of their missing Health.

editorial.name: Spreading Roots
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

editorial.name: Spreading Roots+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 random Emblems and 2 gold.

editorial.name: Staffsmith
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

editorial.name: Stand United
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your units gain 1.5% Attack Damage and 1.5% Ability Power for each non-unique Trait active across your team.

editorial.name: Sun and Moon
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Diana.

editorial.name: Sun and Moon+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and an Aphelios.

editorial.name: Sweet Treats
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains 16 Health for each item equipped on champions.

editorial.name: Sword Overflow
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 4 BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant +4% Attack Speed.

editorial.name: Swordsmith
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 random completed items that build from B.F. Sword.

editorial.name: Tactician's Kitchen
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

editorial.name: Team Building
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats. ; This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.

editorial.name: The Golden Dragon
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +1 team slot but gain 600 Health and 15% Durability. ; Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power. ; Dragonlands Championship, 2022

editorial.name: The Golden Egg
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

editorial.name: The Tower
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

editorial.name: The Trait Tree
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 3 random Emblems and 2 gold.

editorial.name: The Trait Tree+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

editorial.name: Time Skip
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Disable your Shop for the next 3 rounds. Then gain 32 XP.

editorial.name: Tons of Stats!
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

editorial.name: TONS of Stats!
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Your team gains 88 Health, 8% Attack Damage, 8% Ability Power, 8 Armor, 8 Magic Resist, 8% Attack Speed, and 8 Mana.

editorial.name: Trade Sector
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

editorial.name: Trade Sector+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 8 gold.

editorial.name: Trait Ladder
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

editorial.name: Twin Guardians
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 100 Health, 35 Armor, and 35 Magic Resist.

editorial.name: U.R.F
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 20% Attack Speed and 3 Mana Regen.

editorial.name: Upward Mobility
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 2 Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

editorial.name: Urf's Grab Bag
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

editorial.name: Verticality I
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Champions gain 1.5% Attack Damage, 1.5% Ability Power, 1.5 Armor, and 1.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

editorial.name: Verticality II
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Champions gain 2.5% Attack Damage, 2.5% Ability Power, 2 Armor, and 2 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

editorial.name: Verticality III
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Champions gain 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 3.5 Armor, and 3.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

editorial.name: Wand Overflow
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

editorial.name: Warpath
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

editorial.name: We Stick Together
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain an Emblem of a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain 30% Attack Speed. ; Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

editorial.name: Weight The Worth
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

editorial.name: Wisp Rebate+
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 4 gold now.

editorial.name: Wisp Rebate++
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 8 gold now.

editorial.name: Worth the Wait
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

editorial.name: Worth the Wait II
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

editorial.name: Woven Magic
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component.

editorial.name: Young and Wild and Free
editorial.heading: AUGMENTS
editorial.from: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.
